_readme: Regional/alt-form varieties whose OFFICIAL Pokédex color category and/or Genus ('the ___ Pokémon' title) differ from their base species. PokéAPI's species.color and species.genera fields are shared across every variety of a species, so a variety with a genuinely different official color/genus needs an explicit override here — mirrors index.html's VARIANT_OVERRIDES object exactly (same keys, same PokéAPI pokemon-slug names). Researched against Bulbapedia (raw infobox wikitext) + Serebii cross-check, 2026-08-29. Only include a 'color' or 'genus' key when it has been positively confirmed to differ — omitting a key means 'fall back to the base species value', which is correct for every case checked this round except genus on the 5 Hisui/Paldea entries below.

_researched_and_confirmed_no_override_ne.note: These variants were researched this round and confirmed to share the SAME official color and genus as their base form — listed here so future research doesn't re-check them from scratch.
